ent.colonnes_attendues:
**The file is a plain table.** Two columns are enough — a date and an amount. The others sharpen the analysis:

| Column | Role |
|---|---|
| Invoice date | required |
| Amount | required |
| Customer / Supplier | concentration and ranking by party |
| Due date | overdue detection |
| Paid on *(or a Status column)* | actual payment delay |
| Currency | multi-currency analysis |

Headings are recognised in English and French alike: *Invoice date, Customer, Amount, Due date, Paid on, Status…*
